Shop & Craft

Metalworking

Welding, fabrication, and metal shop projects — from furniture to small sculptural pieces.

A collection of metal shop work, ranging from furniture builds to smaller sculptural pieces, each shown here, some from first sketch through finished piece.

Projects

Steel-Frame Desk

A TIG welded steel base with a walnut top, finished in matte black.

Wall Planter

A hand-fabricated, TIG fused geometric planter. Water tight and wall-mounted, holding a spider plant.

Cantilever Shelf

A three-tier shelf built from scrap yard box tube. Bent using a hydraulic draw bender and finished in matte black with quarter sawn oak shelves made to fit. Shown from initial concept sketch to finished unit incorporating large format all-thread and nuts as a supporting center pillar.

Leaf-Pattern Light Fixture

From sketch, to illustrator, to waterjet, this piece was inspired by leaves overlapping in a tree canopy with light filtering through.

Daffodil Sculpture

A geometric take on a daffodil made from scrap steel.
